series_level_findings: ENVIRONMENT: web.archive.org is SITE_BLOCKED here for both /web/<ts>/<url> (incl. id_ variants) and /cdx/search — only http://archive.org/wayback/available works; every Wayback lead below is 'to probe elsewhere'. icpc.global/community/history-icpc-YYYY pages are JS shells (no content). clist.by WF standings start at 1999. cphof.org refuses WebFetch. NTHU ProblemSetArchive index (https://www.cs.nthu.edu.tw/~progcont/ACM/, fetched) has NO Greater New York and NO Rocky Mountain/Mountain sections at all; it has MidAtl 1996 only, MidCen 1995-97, SouthCen 1995-97, SouthEas 1996, SouthCal 1989, EastCen 1993-97, NorthCen 1993-96, plus A_FINALS 1991-98 problem files. WF-1994 FULL STANDINGS: Gordon Cormack's https://plg.uwaterloo.ca/~gvcormac/acmresults/1994.html is live and gives all 35 teams of WF 1994 Phoenix (9 Mar 1994) — worth capturing for wf-1994 if not already held; sibling files 1993/1995/1996/1997.html are 404. It yields regional qualifiers for every fall-1993 NA regional: GNY = Yeshiva (18), Columbia (35); Mid-Atlantic = Duke (3), Virginia Tech (24); Mid-Central = WashU (4), UCA (8), prob. Kentucky (20); Rocky Mountain = BYU (15), CU Boulder (19); South Central = Rice (17), Oklahoma (20), McNeese (34); Southeast = UCF (7), Miami (28), USF (33); Northeast = Harvard (12), MIT (25); Pacific NW = Simon Fraser (23); SoCal = Cal Poly SLO (13), UC Irvine (16); NorCal = Berkeley (6); North Central = Macalester (14), Nebraska-Lincoln (31), Briar Cliff (29); East Central = CMU (22), Michigan (26). GNY: Columbia 'Moment' 03/01/95 (fetched) gives the gny-1994 winner (Columbia; Singh/Soscia/Wu; coach Dragomir Radev; regional held on Long Island). Stony Brook's Skiena page: 1997 GNY at West Point (Stony Brook 1st, Queens College, Cornell). Cornell Chronicle 1999-02-17: 1998 GNY at Bloomfield College NJ on 8 Nov 1998, Cornell 1st, Columbia 2nd, WF Eindhoven 62+1 teams (useful for gny-1998 if needed). acmgnyr.org: zero Wayback captures (availability API empty for bare domain and /year1996/); /year1997/problems.shtml is robots_disallowed to WebFetch; GitHub source starts year1997; Hall of Fame starts 1998. MID-ATLANTIC: UDel (saunders/prog-contest.html) is the best series page: 1995 contest 74 teams (VT Spectrum 18 Jan 1996, VT won; Adam Florence was on VT's team — he is a VT, not GNY, figure); 1996 contest Sat 16 Nov 1996, org site www.csc.vill.edu/~midatl (Villanova), FULL 101-team standings live at https://www.eecis.udel.edu/~saunders/regional96/scores.html (VT 1st, Princeton 2nd, Swarthmore 3rd, Duke 4th/5th/8th, UNC 6th, Lehigh 7th, JHU 9th, Shippensburg 10th) — a capturable standings page for mausa-1996 (not in this brief); 1997-98 org site http://midatl.cslab.vt.edu (VT), UDel a site, contact Keith Decker; 1998 contest Sat 14 Nov 1998, 101 teams. Wayback earliest captures: midatl.cslab.vt.edu 2006-02-16; csc.vill.edu/~midatl 2003-07-11. MID-CENTRAL: archive of problems at mcpc.cigas.net/archives/<year>/ (1998+ linked from SLU), robots-blocked live, Wayback root 2012-11-14; SMSU: cs.smsu.edu/~acm/ Wayback 2002-11-27, cs.smsu.edu/~mcpc/ Wayback 2006-09-02; na.icpc.global/mcna/about has no history. ROCKY MOUNTAIN: rm.na.icpc.global/about and rocky.icpc.io have no pre-2000 history; coloradomesa rmrc pages start at 1999 (RM99Home.html 404 live); cs.montana.edu/paxton/contest robots-blocked; Howard Cheng's page covers 1995-97 from Alberta's side and he is RMC chief judge since 2004 — a person to ask about 1989-94 records, as is Warren MacEvoy (wmacevoy@coloradomesa.edu, current RCD). Charles Shub's live page has nothing. PEOPLE TO ASK: Warren MacEvoy (RMC), Howard Cheng (RMC), B. David Saunders / Keith Decker (UDel, Mid-Atlantic 1997), Michael Goldwasser (SLU, MCPC archive), Dragomir Radev (Columbia coach 1994), Theo Pavlidis / Steven Skiena (Stony Brook GNY).
